Row 3 is a wall at x=1. I need to find where row 3 is passable. Row 3: `###########.#` — only x=11 is open. So the only way to the top area is through (11,3), which connects to (11,2). And (11,2) connects along row 2 to the left. But to get to row 2 from the bottom, I need to pass row 3 — which is only open at x=11. And (11,3) is only reachable from (11,2) or (11,4)=rock.

That means the top area is unreachable from the bottom... unless the rock can be removed. Let me check the rock — maybe I can interact with it.
